steps.name: Home Dashboard (Dark Mode): Remember-Me 3-Tab Header (NEW / DUE / KNOWN) & Flat List Rows
assertions: [data-testid="topbar-memory-file-status"] is visible in the compact 52px topbar
[data-testid="tab-queue"] (NEW), [data-testid="tab-due"] (DUE), and [data-testid="tab-active"] (KNOWN) are visible
[data-testid="passage-deck-list"] displays NEW passages (Romans 8:1-4, Psalm 23:1-6) in flat rows

steps.name: Home Dashboard (Light Mode): Warm Ivory/Parchment Theme Verification
assertions: Clicking [data-testid="btn-toggle-theme"] switches Home Page from Dark Mode to Light Mode (.light-theme)
All Home Page rows, tabs, and floating action buttons render in warm parchment Light Mode

steps.name: Remember-Me Style DUE Tab
assertions: [data-testid="tab-due"] opens [data-testid="due-page-section"]
[data-testid="btn-study-due"] floating play button is visible
Active due cards (Philippians 4:6-7, John 1:1-5) are listed with level/step square badges

steps.name: Copy-Paste Modal - Automatic Verse Number Parsing & Collapsed Peek Verse Boundaries Toggle
assertions: [data-testid="warning-no-verse-numbers"] warns when verse numbers are absent
[data-testid="btn-paste-example"] populates multi-verse scripture passage
[data-testid="btn-peek-verse-boundaries"] shows "(4 verses)" while keeping [data-testid="parsed-verses-preview"] collapsed by default

steps.name: Copy-Paste Modal - Expanded Peek Verse Boundaries Preview
assertions: Clicking [data-testid="btn-peek-verse-boundaries"] expands [data-testid="parsed-verses-preview"]
[data-testid="parsed-verses-preview"] displays all 4 automatically parsed verses ([v. 28]..[v. 31]) for +1v study

steps.name: Remember-Me Style Full-Screen Flashcard Front View (r4.png)
assertions: [data-testid="card-front-view"] and [data-testid="card-reference"] are visible
Circular [data-testid="btn-enter-study"] (🎓) and [data-testid="btn-flip-card"] (◫) are in the bottom bar
[data-testid="stitch-mode-toggle"] with [data-testid="btn-mode-new-verse"] and [data-testid="btn-mode-stitch-block"] is visible
Circular [data-testid="btn-record-voice"] (🎤) is centered at the bottom of the card face

steps.name: Separate First-Letter Study Page - Verse 1 Only with +1w, +1v, and Exit to Flashcard
assertions: Clicking [data-testid="btn-enter-study"] opens separate [data-testid="first-letter-study-page"]
[data-testid="first-letter-study-panel"] shows first letters for Verse 1 only
[data-testid="btn-reveal-1w"] (+1w), [data-testid="btn-reveal-1v"] (+1v), and [data-testid="btn-back-to-card"] are visible

steps.name: Progressive Reveal (+1w and +1v) Completing Verse 1 and Advancing to Verse 2 First Letters
assertions: Clicking +1w 3 times reveals first 3 words of Verse 1
Clicking +1v completes Verse 1 and displays Verse 2 in first-letter mode right below Verse 1
Clicking +1w twice on Verse 2 reveals 2 words of Verse 2 while remaining words stay as first letters

steps.name: Active Voice Recording on Flashcard Front
assertions: [data-testid="btn-back-to-card"] exits Study Page back to [data-testid="card-front-view"]
[data-testid="btn-record-voice"] starts voice recording on the card front
[data-testid="recording-active-indicator"] is active after ~1.2s of recording

steps.name: Card Back View with Auto Voice Playback, Full-Width Scripture Text (r5.png), and Anki Grading Bar
assertions: [data-testid="card-back-view"] is visible
[data-testid="voice-playback-bar"] is visible and auto-playing recorded recitation
[data-testid="card-back-full-text"] displays full-width passage text with tappable verses for repair
[data-testid="anki-grading-bar"] displays AGAIN / HARD / GOOD / EASY buttons

steps.name: Temporary Long-Passage Memory Repair Flashcard Front (Preceding Verse Context Cue + Heal Streak)
assertions: Tapping a verse on the back highlights it in yellow and opens [data-testid="repair-action-sheet"]
Clicking [data-testid="btn-practice-repair-now"] opens the Temporary Memory Repair Flashcard
[data-testid="repair-card-banner"] and [data-testid="repair-heal-progress"] (0/3 heal streak) are visible on the front

steps.name: ProtoJSON (biblememory.v1) Wire-Format Export/Import Modal
assertions: [data-testid="btn-grade-good"] records Anki review log
[data-testid="btn-open-proto-sync"] opens ProtoJSON wire format modal
[data-testid="protojson-textarea"] contains valid biblememory.v1 JSON with passages, flashcards, and reviewLogs

steps.name: Mobile Phone (412x915): Home / Deck Dashboard (NEW, DUE, KNOWN Tabs & Flat List Rows)
assertions: 412x915 Android phone viewport renders 52px topbar, 3-tab header (NEW / DUE / KNOWN), and flat list rows without clipping
Floating bottom ▶ and + action buttons are cleanly positioned in the bottom-right corner

steps.name: Mobile Phone (412x915): Full-Screen Flashcard Front (r4.png)
assertions: 412x915 Android phone viewport renders full-screen Flashcard Front with compact 52px topbar and stitch strip
No false LEAD-IN context cue box appears on Full-Passage review
Circular 💡 hint button at top-center, centered reference, circular 🎤 mic button, and bottom bar (🎓 | counter | ◫)

steps.name: Mobile Phone (412x915): Separate First-Letter Study Page (+1w and +1v Progression)
assertions: 412x915 Android phone viewport renders First-Letter Study Page with full-width verse cards and bottom +1w / +1v controls

steps.name: Mobile Phone (412x915): Flashcard Back / Full-Width Verse Review (r5.png)
assertions: 412x915 Android phone viewport renders full-width scripture text from edge to edge with zero side-button squishing
AnkiDroid-style 4-button grading bar (AGAIN / HARD / GOOD / EASY) spans the bottom edge cleanly

assertions: Tapping a verse on mobile highlights it in warm amber/yellow without squishing the text column
[data-testid="repair-action-sheet"] displays Queue Repair & Resume, Forgot From Here Onward, and Practice Repair Now above the 4-button Anki bar
